title: feat(service-knowledge): search inside chosen records — the record scope, by the records a source indexes or by a parent through a listed lookup
body:
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8GWXHtfAHuZXmmZpkARr4Wi)_ Fixes #37308 Clause-②: yes Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - 用户能看到什么变化：知识检索可以限定范围了：只在指定的几条记录里找，或者只在一份上级记录（比如一份制度）下面的条款里找，返回的前几条结果都来自范围内。 - 为什么做：属于「知识检索平台化」专题第三阶段，按您定的「也能指定上级对象（制度）」实现；之后给 AI 用的检索工具也会接上这个参数。 - 出错会怎样：范围只会缩小结果，不会放宽权限，每条结果仍按提问人的权限重新读取；最坏是限定范围后漏掉结果。没有数据迁移，撤回即可。 - 要你做什么：无需你操作。您已在卡片上同意的安全登记行已在（`d1ca7f01`）。开源向量库那个改动先合并了，本分支已合入主干，并让向量库也按范围过滤（在数据库里先筛再排序）；由座位做差量复核后重新排队合并。「按记录返回」已合并并合入本分支；与开源向量库那个改动仍有文字冲突，后合并的一方处理。 ## What changes ADR-0161 K8 item 17, in the shape its dated note of 2026-11-25 (#37324, merged as `13ffe1c0`) gives it, built in one PR as the note says: the member, its first reader in `knowledge-memory`, and the suite cases. **`@objectstack/spec`** (types only, no metadata key): - `KnowledgeSearchOptions.scope?: Array<{ object: string; ids: string[] }>` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/knowledge-service.ts`): an option of the service, not a contract member. Its TSDoc states the own-object and parent readings, union, absent/empty, and the bounds with the coded refusal. - `AdapterSearchOptions.scope?: AdapterScopeTerm[]` and the exported type `AdapterScopeTerm` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/knowledge-adapter.ts`): `{ kind: 'record', ids }` or `{ kind: 'metadata', field, ids }`. Its TSDoc states absent/present/empty, the AND with `organizationIds` and `filter`, the bounds an adapter can rely on (at most 10 terms, at most 500 ids each, every id a non-empty string), and that the service checks every hit after the answer, so an adapter returns the document's `metadata` on its hits. - Regenerated: `api-surface/contracts.json`, `export-origins/contracts.json` (the new export). **`@objectstack/service-knowledge`**: - New `src/knowledge-search-scope.ts`: - `readSearchScope`: the bounds, `SEARCH_SCOPE_MAX_ENTRIES = 10`, `SEARCH_SCOPE_MAX_IDS = 500`. Past them it throws `code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR'`, `status: 400` (ADR-0112), naming the bound, before anything else in `search` runs. - `scopeTermsFor`: an entry naming the source's object gives a `record` term. An entry naming another object gives a `metadata` term on the one `metadataFields` member that is a `lookup` or `master_detail` field whose `referenceTargetOf` is that object, read from the registered definition. A `user` field, a withheld (credential-class or `internal`) field, a field whose target cannot be read, two or more such fields, no definition, and a `file` / `http` source all give nothing. - `scopeCheck`: the hit check. It judges `sourceRecordId` or `metadata[field]`, compares strings and numbers by `String(v)`, and matches a list when any element matches. Anything else, or no value, fails closed. - `KnowledgeService.search`: - Validates first. - `sourcesInScope` pairs each admitted source with its terms. A source no entry reaches is not searched (debug). The two-lookup ambiguity is logged once per source and object at `warn`, naming the fields. - `searchRound` hands each adapter a copy of its terms and checks every hit after the answer. The first drop for an adapter is logged once at `warn`. - `answered` stays the adapter's own count. - `src/testing.ts` (the contract suite): - New required `implements.scope`. - Adapter-alone cases, run when `implements.scope` is true: a record term filters before ranking (topK 1); a metadata term with a list value returns the document's metadata; the number 7 matches `'7'`; terms are a union; an empty list or a term with no ids ranks nothing; without the member everything is ranked; with `organizationIds`, both apply. - Cases through a real `KnowledgeService` for every adapter: an own-object scope fills topK from in-scope passages; a parent scope works through the listed lookup; an adapter with the member stripped answers no out-of-scope hit, and the service logs once. - `serviceOver` gains `schemas`, `stripScope` and `logger`. **`@objectstack/knowledge-memory`**: applies `scope` after the organization filter and before scoring. It declares `implements.scope: true`. **`@objectstack/knowledge-pgvector`** (landed first, #37337): applies `scope` in the same inner `WHERE` as the organization filter, before `ORDER BY` / `LIMIT`. A `record` term is `source_record_id = ANY($n::text[])`; a `metadata` term holds when the stored jsonb value of its field is a string or number equal to an id as text, or a list with such an element. Ids and field names are bound parameters only. A scope with no term that has ids answers `[]` before any query. Its live contract run declares `implements.scope: true`. **Docs**: - `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx`: a new "Record scope" section in §5, a pointer in §3.4, the suite sample, and §4.1 / the adapter table naming pgvector's record scope. - `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx`: a new "Searching inside chosen records" section. **Changeset**: patch for the four packages, with `Clause-②: yes` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. The change adds no metadata key, and a non-protocol widening ships patch. ## Tests - New `src/__tests__/knowledge-search-scope.test.ts`: bounds (each refusal, and the exact-bound acceptance), term building (each reading of the note), and the hit check. - `src/__tests__/knowledge-service.test.ts`, new describe "search scope (ADR-0161 K8, item 17)": - the card's acceptance: 20 records, two in scope, topK 5, a full page; - an ignoring adapter: no out-of-scope hit, one log; - an unreached object: no adapter asked, empty answer; - an unreadable scoped record yields no hit; - the bounds refuse before any adapter or engine call; - empty scope and empty ids answer nothing; - the two-lookup case logs once; - a numeric lookup value matches its string id; - a parent scope makes no engine call naming the parent object, and an adapter that widens the terms it was handed (more ids, an extra term) still has every out-of-scope hit dropped; every round is handed the service's own terms (review round 1); - a scope with `groupBy`, and one with `granularity: 'record'`, over an adapter that ignores the scope: every round is handed the record term and no out-of-scope record answers (review round 2). - The contract suite runs on `knowledge-memory` and both stubs. - Mutation checks, run locally and reverted: - `knowledge-memory` with its scope filter removed: 7 suite cases fail. - `KnowledgeService` without the after-answer check: 7 cases fail across the stubs and the service tests. - Handing the adapter the live terms, or reading the parent object's definition: the round-1 case fails. - Skipping the scope under `groupBy`, skipping it under record granularity, or the `groupBy` source filter rebuilding its entries without the terms: the round-2 case fails. **Local runs at `760716bc`** (after merging `main` at `98bda0ac`, which brought #37337): - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` and `check:generated`: exit 0, after the merge's deferred regeneration of `api-surface/contracts.json` and `export-origins/contracts.json` (`4552e7c4`). - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-knowledge typecheck` and `check:test-typecheck`: exit 0. `test`: 13 files, 365 tests passed. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/knowledge-memory typecheck` and `check:test-typecheck`: exit 0. `test`: 2 files, 56 tests passed. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/knowledge-pgvector typecheck`: exit 0. `test` against a local PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector, `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL` set and `OS_EXPECT_LIVE_DIALECT_MATRIX=1`: 4 files, 67 tests passed, every scope case of the suite among them (record term, metadata term with a list, the number 7, union, empty, absent, with `organizationIds`; through the service: own object, the parent through the listed lookup, the member stripped). With the SQL scope filter removed: 7 of them fail. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test:repo` (the census pin, at `d1ca7f01`): 8 files, 110 tests passed. - **Derived gates at `760716bc`.** `dispatch-gates --commands` derives 119 commands from the 19 changed paths (the 118 before, plus `pnpm check:kernel-hook-pairs`). Each was run at this head with its output in its own file and its exit code read before any pipe. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered 3 (prerequisite not met: the new `knowledge-pgvector` had no `dist/`); after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/knowledge-pgvector build` it was run again, and the record holds that run. ```text Run reconciliation — 119 derived, 119 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. ✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 119 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 119 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 119 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3). ```

Earlier heads ran the 118 then derived, all exit 0: `857a2e20` (after three prerequisites were met) and `ca5a0c11`. ## Acceptance notes **The five points carried from #37329's contract review:** 1. **Metadata on hits.** The requirement that an adapter return the document's `metadata` is stated on `AdapterSearchOptions.scope` and on `KnowledgeHit.metadata` (`packages/spec/src/ai/knowledge-document.zod.ts`, added in the merge of `main` under the seat's claim amendment, review ruling (b)). It is pinned: the suite's metadata-term case and the parent case through the service both assert `hit.metadata.policy`. 2. **Ids compared as strings.** Pinned on `scopeCheck`, on the adapter in the suite, and through the service (a lookup stored as the number 7 matches `'7'`). Only strings and numbers compare. An object, `null` or a boolean never matches, so `'[object Object]'` cannot be matched by accident. 3. **An empty scope or an entry with no ids.** It is answered empty, never refused and never read as "no scope", and no adapter is asked. Why empty rather than refused: it reads as an empty set reads everywhere else in this contract (`organizationIds: []`). A caller that computes ids (the records on screen, a policy's children) then needs no special case for "none". The tool argument (#37311) can still refuse at its own door. 4. **Bounds.** 10 entries and 500 ids per entry are stated on both TSDocs and pinned. The 500 ids of one term fit one `IN` list, and a search hands at most 5,000 ids in all. ⚑ This PR owes a ceiling-tier contract review (CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER) for the new member. 5. **The opaque `filter`.** Finding for the seat to file: `KnowledgeSearchOptions.filter` / `AdapterSearchOptions.filter` has no producer in this tree. The one non-test caller of `IKnowledgeService.search`, `createKnowledgeTools`, passes none, and the service gives it no guarantee after the answer. This PR leaves it unchanged and builds nothing from it. Whether it retires is its own card. Carrier: none · noted, not filed. Dedupe words: knowledge opaque filter, AdapterSearchOptions filter retire, KnowledgeSearchOptions filter producer. **What the note left to this PR, decided here:** - **Refill.** `answered` stays the adapter's own count, so whether a source may hold more is still judged on what it returned. The refill after the permission filter counts records among the hits that passed both checks. - A person's search over an ignoring adapter therefore still reaches in-scope hits through the refill. - The system identity gets one round, and may answer fewer than topK (pinned). - **Log levels.** - An adapter whose hits the check drops: `warn`, once per adapter. It is a deployment defect, and rule 2 says nothing is skipped silently. - Two lookups to one parent: `warn`, once per source and object. It is an authoring defect. - A source a scope does not reach: `debug`, per search, because it is normal under a scope. - Counts appear in logs only, never in the answer. - **Entry shape.** An entry with another key (for example `field`) is refused rather than ignored. A `field` key is the note's deferred alternative, so it fails loud instead of silently reading as something else. An id that is not a non-empty string is refused: the contract types ids as strings, and a stored numeric value still matches its string id. **Surface and overlap:** - Outside the claimed file list: the two generated spec artifacts (`api-surface/contracts.json`, `export-origins/contracts.json`), required by `check:generated` for the new export. - `packages/spec/src/ai/knowledge-document.zod.ts`: one TSDoc sentence, inside the claim as the seat amended it. - `packages/core/src/security/second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts`: one `CALLERS` row, kind `not-a-served-read`, for `knowledge-search-scope.ts`, in its own commit `d1ca7f01`, after the maintainer approved it on the card thread (2026-11-25 22:48Z). The census pin requires every caller of `referenceTargetOf` to be classified; the seat's review agrees with the kind. The row cites the service case that a parent-scoped search makes no engine call naming the parent object. Run at `d1ca7f01`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test:repo`, 8 files, 110 tests passed. - No `scripts/adr-anchors` entry: review ruling (c), not owed. - `knowledge-ragflow` does not run the suite and ignores `scope` (#37004 retires it). The service's check keeps its answers in scope. A parent scope answers nothing from it if its hits carry no metadata. - #37337 (#37100, pgvector) merged before this PR's queue run, and `main` is merged again at `93c70347`. `searchWithRefusals` validates the scope first; the admitted sources are filtered by the scope, then by `groupBy`, then planned (`planSearches` carries each source's terms beside its fingerprint, `SearchTarget.scope`), and `searchRound` hands the adapter both `index` and `scope`. The suite's `implements`, the stubs, `knowledge-memory` and the protocol sample declare the generation keys and `scope`. - #37335 (record-level return) merged first, and `main` was merged into this branch at `67f11a57`. `search()` validates the scope, `groupBy` and `granularity` first, then filters the admitted sources by the scope (`sourcesInScope`) and then by `groupBy` (`sourcesGroupableBy`). Every round of the record-level path goes through `searchRound`, so every round is handed the terms and checked. - `packages/plugins/knowledge-pgvector/**`: inside the claim as the seat widened it after #37337 landed (#37308 item 4): the scope filter in `search()`, `implements.scope`, and nothing else. - `overlap-check` at `760716bc`: `main`, #37265 and #37187 merge cleanly. ## Verification Read first: 1. `packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-search-scope.ts`: the whole module (bounds, term building, hit check). 2. `KnowledgeService.search` / `sourcesInScope` / `searchRound` / `checkScope` in `knowledge-service.ts`: the three-line change at the top of `search`, and the check after the answer. 3. The two TSDocs in `packages/spec/src/contracts/`. Two-minute check: run `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-knowledge exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/__tests__/knowledge-search-scope.test.ts src/__tests__/knowledge-service.test.ts -t scope`. Then open the "search scope" describe and read the acceptance case "20 records, two of them in scope, topK 5". --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_01JQwxbZmjM1KubX3ZAoJPPm)_
